title: r4agent 0.1.0
text: Initial release. agent_suite(), agent_case(), agent_thresholds() read_agent_suite() define benchmark suite: cases expected answer, slice severity, plus slice thresholds agreed run. run_benchmark() runs agent language model suite score_slices() grades results locally deterministically, model called judge another model. readiness() returns production readiness answer, consistency() checks run--run stability, diff_runs() surfaces case used pass now fails instead averaging away. agent_evidence() emits results R4SUB evidence rows via ‘r4subcore’, report_markdown() writes shareable report. register_grader() graders_available() expose pluggable, offline grader interface.
